typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePath as string ('\\ cslnhf501.wellsfargo.com\\DRSProd\\WFSOpsKRIReporting\\DropZone\\Calypsofx\\executedTrades'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade Id} as string,
		{Fenics Id} as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Entered Date} as string,
		{Entered User} as string,
		{Entered User Name} as string,
		{Modification Date} as string,
		{Entity Field Name} as string,
		{Old Value} as string,
		{New Value} as string,
		{Modified User} as string,
		{Modified User Name} as string,
		{Trade Version} as string,
		{Audit Action} as string,
		{Trade Status} as string,
		Trader as string,
		{Processing Org} as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		Book as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FileName = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(90), toInteger(120)))),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(123), toInteger(10))))) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 derive({Copy of FileDate} = toDate(FileDate, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Fenics_Id as string,
		Modified_User as string,
		Trade_Date as string,
		Modified_User_Name as string,
		Processing_Org as string,
		Entered_User as string,
		Trader as string,
		Trade_Status as string,
		FileName as string,
		Trade_Id as string,
		Old_Value as string,
		Modification_Date as string,
		New_Value as string,
		Entered_User_Name as string,
		FileDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Trade_Version as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		Audit_Action as string,
		Book as string,
		Entity_Field_Name as string,
		Product_Type as string,
		Entered_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Fenics_Id = {Fenics Id},
		Modified_User = {Modified User},
		Trade_Date = {Trade Date},
		Modified_User_Name = {Modified User Name},
		Processing_Org = {Processing Org},
		Entered_User = {Entered User},
		Trader,
		Trade_Status = {Trade Status},
		FileName,
		Trade_Id = {Trade Id},
		Old_Value = {Old Value},
		Modification_Date = {Modification Date},
		New_Value = {New Value},
		Entered_User_Name = {Entered User Name},
		FileDate = {Copy of FileDate},
		Trade_Version = {Trade Version},
		Counterparty,
		Audit_Action = {Audit Action},
		Book,
		Entity_Field_Name = {Entity Field Name},
		Product_Type = {Product Type},
		Entered_Date = {Entered Date}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
